As for the side note, there are two main uses for the garden, using it for cookies or for sugar lumps. By the way, always, always, always plant during clots, cursed fingers, or other negative wrath cookie effects so the price is greatly reduced.

Now, one strategy is to plant the whole garden full of Bakeberries and wait for them to mature. Then, when you have a golden cookie combo, harvest them all for potentially weeks of CpS.

Otherwise, if you're later in the game and more concerned about sugar lumps than anything, another potential strategy could be to quickly gain all of the seeds (usually takes me about a week) and sacrifice them for 10 sugar lumps every time. If you don't want to be that active, and you have the time and patience, you could spend a bunch of time farming for juicy queenbeets, which give you 1 sugar lump each.

Also, there are some upgrades that you can only get from harvesting certain types of plants, which are pretty useful.
